import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.nn.functional as F
import torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(29500+ws)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=100, hidden_size=32, intermediate_size=64, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    model = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float()
    ref = LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float(); ref.load_state_dict(model.state_dict())
    inputs = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    targets = [torch.randint(0,100,(2,8)) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    rl = 0
    for i,t in zip(inputs, targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(i).logits.reshape(-1,100), t.reshape(-1))/3; l.backward(); rl += l.item()
    if rank == ws-1: print("loss", loss.item(), rl)
    maxd = 0
    for (n,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None: maxd = max(maxd, (p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(rank, "grad params", sum(p.grad is not None for p in model.parameters()), "maxdiff", maxd)
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for ws in (1,2): mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
